title: Story premise EDU001: The Half-Platform Problem
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (basic math). Hook: Which platform is actually longer? Takeaway/theme: Equivalent fractions describe the same amount when the whole stays fixed.
description: A conductor must connect two half-length platforms, but differently divided tiles make the lengths look unequal. Sliding both onto the same unit rail reveals equivalent fractions and completes the bridge.
